item.title: Presidential Suite at Jayewardenepura Hospital opened to public
item.description: The special ward at the Sri Jayewardenepura General Hospital, which had until now been reserved exclusively for the use of the Executive President, has been opened for the general public for medical treatment from today (24), the Presidents Media Division stated

item.title: Food security a top priority, President directs action on fertiliser stocks
item.description: Ensuring food security in the country and people remains a top priority of the government, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has emphasised

item.description: Iran has named a former Iranian Revolutionary Guard commander as the new secretary of the countrys Supreme National Security Council, replacing Ali Larijani, who was killed in an airstrike

item.title: Ex-SriLankan Airlines Chief Nishantha Wickramasinghe granted bail following arrest
item.description: The Colombo Magistrates Court has ordered the release on bail of former Chairman of SriLankan Airlines Nishantha Wickramasinghe, who was arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) on charges of corruption

item.title: Lebanon declares Iranian ambassador persona non grata amid Israeli attacks
item.description: Lebanon ⁠has ⁠withdrawn accreditation from the Iranian ambassador ⁠and declared him ⁠persona non grata, demanding his departure from Lebanon by Sunday, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said on Tuesday

item.title: Individual arrested for allegedly hoarding 6,600 litres of diesel in Gonapola
item.description: An individual has been arrested for allegedly hoarding large quantities of fuel using a bowser truck by the Walana Anti-Vice Squad in Gonapola

item.title: Philippines declares energy emergency over Middle East conflict risks
item.description: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr on Tuesday declared a state of national energy emergency in response to the Middle East conflict and what he called an imminent danger posed to the countrys energy supply
